blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Recent advances have enabled unified omni-modal models in understanding audio, vision, and language.
However, existing benchmarks, training data, and learning methods largely treat the modalities independently, leaving the capability of audio-visual joint reasoning poorly evaluated and insufficiently elicited.
We address this gap with a benchmark, data engine, and learning method.
First, we introduce OmniReasoningBench , a benchmark where both audio and visual evidence are indispensable. It comprises 1,150 multiple-choice and open-ended questions across two tasks, reasoning over video and reasoning beyond video .
Second, we develop a data engine OmniQA . It automatically constructs evidence-grounded QA pairs that explicitly necessitate audio-visual joint reasoning, together with timestamped clue chains that guide the annotation of thinking process. Besides our benchmark, this engine produces training data OmniReasoning-SFT-112K and OmniReasoning-RL-19K.
Finally, we propose an on-policy self-distillation method Modality-Factored Self-Distillation (MFSD) . It evaluates each sampled response under modality-specific clue contexts, disentangling the contributions of individual clues and their cross-modal interactions for token-level credit assignment.
With our training data and learning method, our model OmniReasoning-30B-A3B achieves 50.0% on OmniVideoBench and 42.5% on OmniReasoningBench, improving the base model Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking by 12.8 and 9.3 percentage points, respectively. Moreover, it delivers substantial gains on general and long-video benchmarks, including Video-MME-v2.
We hope our work offers a solid step for facilitating future research in omni-modal joint reasoning.
blocks.zh:
最近的进展使得在理解音频、视觉和语言方面能够采用统一的全方位模式。
然而,现有的基准、培训数据和学习方法基本上独立地对待这些模式,使视听联合推理的能力没有得到很好的评价,也没有得到充分的启发。
我们用基准、数据引擎和学习方法来解决这一差距。
首先,我们引入了OmniReasoning Bench, 一个音频和视觉证据都是不可或缺的基准。 包括1 150个多选择和开放式问题,
第二,我们开发一个数据引擎OmniQA。 它会自动构建证据依据的QA对,明确要求视听联合推理,同时会构建时间标注的线索链,指导思维过程的注释. 除了我们的基准,这个引擎还生成训练数据OmniReasoning-SFT-112K和OmniReasoning-RL-19K.
最后,我们提出一种政策上的自我消化方法 -- -- 方法 -- -- 促成自我消化。 它根据特定模式的线索背景评价每个抽样答复,揭示了单个线索的贡献及其用于象征性信用分配的跨模式互动。
通过我们的训练数据和学习方法,我们的OmniReasoning-30B-A3B模型在OmniVideo Bench上实现了50.0%,在OmniReasoning Bench上实现了42.5%,使基模型Qune3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking分别提高了12.8%和9.3个百分点. 此外,它在一般和长视频基准,包括Video-MME-v2方面,也取得了实质性成果。
我们希望,我们的工作为便利今后研究全方位联合推理提供了一个坚实的步骤。

blocks.en:
Figure 1: OmniReasoning: a benchmark, data engine and learning method for audio-visual joint reasoning. Unlike previous benchmarks, our benchmark OmniReasoningBench truly requires both audio and visual inputs for joint reasoning.
Besides this benchmark, our data engine OmniQA additionally produces large-scale training data with evidence-grounded questions.
Further, our learning method MFSD leverages the gain from cross-modality joint clues to assign credit at token level, enabling effective exploration along audio-visual joint reasoning. In comparison, previous method GRPO offers only outcome-level guidance, and RLSD does not consider cross-modality interaction.
With our training data and learning method, our model achieves large improvements over base model on audio-visual, long video, and general video benchmarks.

图1:OmniReasoning:用于视听联合推理的基准,数据引擎和学习方法. 与以前的基准不同,我们的基准OmniReasoning Bench确实需要音频和视觉输入来进行联合推理。
除了这个基准,我们的数据引擎 OmniQA还制作了大规模培训数据,并附有有证据依据的问题。
此外,我们的学习方法MFSD利用跨模式联合线索的收益,在象征性层面分配信用,从而能够沿着视听联合推理进行有效探索。 相比之下,之前的方法GPRO只提供结果层面的指导,而RLSD并不考虑跨模式的相互作用.
通过我们的培训数据和学习方法,我们的模型比视听、长视频和一般视频基准的基本模型有了很大的改进。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Understanding real-world videos often requires reasoning across what has been heard and what has been seen.
Consider the example in Figure 1 : to determine the gap between a mother’s birth year and the year engraved inside a ring, a model has to combine a spoken age with an observed calendar date, infer the corresponding birth year, and then compare it with the engraving.
Neither modality alone provides sufficient evidence. The answer emerges only by connecting information across modalities. We refer to this capability as audio-visual joint reasoning .
Recent omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs), such as Qwen-Omni ( qwen25omni ; qwen3omni ) and Nemotron 3 Nano Omni ( nemotron3omni ) , have made substantial progress toward unified audio-vision-language understanding. However, whether these omni models can reliably perform such cross-modal reasoning remains largely unclear.
blocks.zh:
了解真实世界的视频往往需要通过所听到的和所看到的来推理.
参考图1中的例子:为了确定母亲出生年份与刻在环内年份之间的差距,一个模型必须把口语年龄与被观测的日历日期结合起来,推断出相应的出生年份,然后将其与雕刻作比较.
这两种方式都不足以提供证据。 答案只能通过将各种模式的信息联系起来而出现。 我们将此能力称为视听联合推理。
近期的全米模式大语言模型(英语:Omni-LLMs),如Quen-Omni(英语:qwen25omni; qwen3omni)和Nemotron 3 Nano Omni(英语:Nemotron3omni),在统一音频-视觉-语言理解方面取得了实质性进展. 然而,这些全方位模型是否能够可靠地进行这种跨模式推理,在很大程度上仍然不清楚。

blocks.en:
A fundamental obstacle is that existing benchmarks do not consistently make joint reasoning necessary.
Several recent audio-visual benchmarks ( worldsense ; dailyomni ; omnivideobench ; jointavbench ) position themselves as evaluations of omni-modal understanding and conduct modality ablation experiments.
However, ablation studies do not fully validate that a benchmark actually requires information from multiple modalities to answer the questions.
In our experiments, Qwen3.5-Plus ( qwen35blog ) achieves 57.85%, 68.76%, 44.90%, and 60.43% accuracy on WorldSense, Daily-Omni, OmniVideoBench, and JointAVBench, respectively, when provided with visual-only inputs and no audio .
These results indicate that a substantial fraction of the questions remain answerable without audio, limiting the extent to which such benchmarks can distinguish genuine audio-visual joint reasoning from strong single-modality understanding.
blocks.zh:
一个根本障碍是,现有基准并不始终使联合推理成为必要。
最近的一些视听基准(世界语:日报:日报:日报:日报:日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报-日报)将自己定位为对全面模式的理解和进行试验的评价。
然而,减征研究并不能充分证实一个基准实际上需要来自多种方式的信息来回答问题.
在我们的实验中,Quen3.5-Plus(qwen35blog )在提供仅可视化输入且无音频的情况下,分别实现了WorldSense,Daily-Omni,OmniVideo Bench和JointAV Bench的准确度57.85%,68.76%,44.90%和60.43%.
这些结果表明,很大一部分问题仍然可以回答,没有声音,限制了这些基准能够在多大程度上区分真正的视听联合推理和强烈的单一模式理解。

blocks.en:
Motivated by these findings, we introduce OmniReasoning , a unified framework for evaluating and eliciting omni-modal joint reasoning through explicit modality-specific evidence.
At its core is OmniReasoningBench , a benchmark of 1,150 multiple-choice and open-ended questions spanning two settings: reasoning over video , which requires connecting observations across events within a video, and reasoning beyond video , which applies information derived from a video to a new scenario or figure.
The questions are deliberately constructed around dependencies between audio and visual observations, thereby minimizing the possibility of solving them from a single modality alone.
Take Figure 1 as an example, when Qwen3.5-Plus model evaluated without audio, the accuracy drops to 17.2% and 8.7% on the multiple-choice and open-ended questions, respectively.
Moreover, our ablation studies show that audio-visual joint reasoning provides gains beyond either modality alone, with improvements exceeding the gains obtained from simply combining the questions solved independently by the two modalities. Together, these results demonstrate that the benchmark is able to test the capability of integrating complementary evidence across modalities.
blocks.zh:
基于这些结论,我们引入了OmniReasoning(OmniReasoning),这是一个通过明确的具体模式证据来评价和引申全方位模式联合推理的统一框架。
其核心是OmniReasoning Bench, 由1,150个多重选择和开放式问题构成的基准,
这些问题是围绕音频和视觉观测之间的依赖性而刻意构建的,从而最大限度地减少了仅用一种单一方式解决这些问题的可能性。
以图1为例,当Quen3.5-Plus模型在没有音频的情况下评价时,在多选题和开放式问题上,精度分别下降到17.2%和8.7%.
此外,我们的研究显示,视听联合推理提供了超出两种模式之外的好处,改进之处超过了简单地将两种模式独立解决的问题结合起来所获得的收益。 这些结果共同表明,基准能够检验将补充证据纳入各种模式的能力。

blocks.en:
Making such questions at scale, however, presents a second challenge: training data has to preserve the same evidence dependencies rather than merely pair arbitrary audio, visual, and textual content.
To address this, we develop a data engine OmniQA , which automatically constructs evidence-grounded questions that explicitly link audio and visual observations. In addition to generating question-answer pairs, OmniQA produces timestamped clues and dependency chains that connect observed evidence to intermediate inferences and the final answer (Figure 3 ).
After verification, these reasoning chains are used to synthesize thinking processes for supervised fine-tuning, yielding OmniReasoning-SFT-112K .
The modality-specific clue annotations are also retained as structured supervision for reinforcement learning, resulting in OmniReasoning-RL-19K .
Thus, OmniQA provides not only the benchmark and large-scale training data, but also an explicit representation of how evidence from different modalities contributes to a reasoning process.
blocks.zh:
然而,将这类问题放在规模上是第二个挑战:培训数据必须保留同样的证据依赖性,而不仅仅是任意的音频、视觉和文字内容。
为了解决这个问题,我们开发了一个数据引擎OmniQA,它自动构造证据依据的问题,将视听观测明确联系起来。 除了生成问答对,OmniQA还生成时间标注的线索和依赖链,将观测到的证据连接到中间推论和最终答案(图3 ).
经过验证,这些推理链被用来合成受监督的微调的思维过程,生成OmniReasoning-SFT-112K.
模式特有的线索说明也被保留作为强化学习的结构化监督,导致OmniReasoning-RL-19K. .
因此,OmniQA不仅提供基准和大规模培训数据,而且还明确表明不同模式的证据如何有助于推理过程。

blocks.en:
The same evidence structure further enables a more targeted learning objective.
Existing reasoning-oriented post-training methods ( grpo ; gspo ; dapo ) typically assign credit to a response according to its overall quality, without distinguishing whether a prediction is supported by audio evidence, visual evidence, or their interaction.
We therefore propose Modality-Factored Self-Distillation (MFSD) , an on-policy self-distillation method that factors token-level credit assignment according to modality-specific evidence.
As in Figure 1 , for each sampled response, the model evaluates the token likelihood under four types of clue context: no clues, audio clues, visual clues, and joint audio-visual clues.
The resulting likelihood difference quantifies both the contribution of individual modalities and the non-additive interaction between them.
Specifically, MFSD measures the interaction by subtracting the individual audio and visual gains from the gain obtained under joint clues, and combines this interaction with the overall support provided by the joint clues to derive fine-grained token-level supervision through the weighting mechanism of RLSD ( rlsd ) .
This design explicitly encourages the model to generate reasoning steps that rely on complementary cross-modal evidence rather than exploiting one modality in isolation.
blocks.zh:
同样的证据结构进一步使学习目标更具针对性。
现有的注重推理的训练后方法(grpo;gspo;dapo)通常会根据其整体质量对响应进行授记,而不区分预测是辅以音频证据,视觉证据还是其相互作用.
因此,我们提议采用 " 模式 -- -- 促成自我分裂 " (MFSD),这是一种政策上的自我分裂方法,根据特定模式的证据,将象征性的信用分配作为因素。
如图1所示,对于每个被抽样的响应,模型在四种线索上下文下评价象征性可能性:无线索,音频线索,视觉线索,以及联合视听线索.
由此产生的可能性差异既量化了个别方式的贡献,又量化了它们之间的非附加互动。
具体来说,MFSD通过从联合线索下获得的收益中减去个人音频和视觉收益来测量相互作用,并将这种相互作用与联合线索提供的整体支持结合起来,通过RLSD(rlsd)的权重机制得出精细的符号级监督.
这一设计明确鼓励该模型产生依赖于互补的跨模式证据的推理步骤,而不是孤立地利用一种模式。

blocks.en:
Combining the OmniQA training data with MFSD yields our model OmniReasoning-30B-A3B . It achieves 50.0% accuracy on OmniVideoBench and 42.5% on OmniReasoningBench, improving over the baseline (Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking) by 12.8 and 9.3 percentage points, respectively.
Beyond the targeted evaluation, the model also delivers substantial improvements on general and long-video understanding benchmarks, including LVOmniBench, Video-MMMU, and Video-MME-v2.
These results suggest that explicitly constructing, annotating, and optimizing for cross-modal evidence dependencies can strengthen not only audio-visual joint reasoning, but also broader video understanding.
We hope that OmniReasoning provides a unified foundation for studying and improving joint reasoning across modalities in future omni-modal models.
blocks.zh:
将 OmniQA 训练数据与 MFSD 合并后, 我们的模型 OmniReasoning-30B-A3B 。 它在OmniVideo Bench和OmniReasoning Bench上的精度分别达到50.0%和42.5%,比基线(Qune3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking)分别提高了12.8%和9.3个百分点.
除了目标明确的评价外,该模式还大大改进了一般和长视频理解基准,包括LVOMNI Bench、Video-MMMU和Video-MME-v2。
这些结果表明,明确构建、注释和优化跨模式证据依赖不仅能够加强视听联合推理,而且能够加强更广泛的视频理解。
我们希望OmniReasoning为研究和改进未来所有模式模式之间的联合推理提供一个统一的基础。

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: 1. A benchmark for genuine audio-visual joint reasoning . We introduce OmniReasoningBench, a benchmark where audio and visual observations are jointly necessary, enabling a more rigorous evaluation of omni-modal reasoning. 2. An evidence-grounded data engine for joint reasoning . We develop OmniQA, an automated data engine that constructs audio-visual QA pairs together with timestamped clues and dependency chains, providing explicit supervision for cross-modal training. 3. A modality-aware learning method for joint reasoning . We propose MFSD, a reinforcement learning method that highlights cross-modality interactions and offers token-level credit assignment. Combined with OmniQA data, MFSD substantially improves both audio-visual joint reasoning and general video understanding.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献概述如下: 1. 真正的视听联合推理基准 我们引入了OmniReasoning Bench,这是一个共同需要视听观测的基准,能够更严格地评价全方位模式推理。 2. 联合推理的循证数据引擎 我们开发了OmniQA,这是一个自动数据引擎,将视听QA对联与时间标注的线索和依赖链一起构建,为跨模式培训提供明确的监督. 3. 共同推理模式意识学习方法 我们提出MFSD,是一种强化的学习方法,它突出跨模式的相互作用,并提供象征性的信用分配. MFSD与OmniQA数据相结合,大大改善了视听联合推理和一般视频理解.

We propose MFSD, a reinforcement learning method that highlights cross-modality interactions and offers token-level credit assignment. Combined with OmniQA data, MFSD substantially improves both audio-visual joint reasoning and general video understanding.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Omni-LLMs and audio-visual joint reasoning. Recent omni-modal models support native audio-visual understanding ( gemini3models ; doubao2 ; musespark ; mimov25 ; qwen25omni ; qwen3omni ; qwen35omni ; videosalmonn2 ; nemotron3omni ) . WorldSense ( worldsense ) , Daily-Omni ( dailyomni ) , OmniVideoBench ( omnivideobench ) , and LVOmniBench ( lvomnibench ) benchmark this capability. JointAVBench ( jointavbench ) explicitly evaluates cross-modality dependence. AV-Reasoner ( avreasoner ) studies clue-grounded counting and Video-MMMU ( videommmu ) tests knowledge acquisition from instructional videos. In contrast, our benchmark necessitates joint reasoning over audio and visual observations.
blocks.zh: Omni-LLMs和视听联合推理. 近期的全美模式模式支持本土的视听理解(gemini3模型; doubao2; musispark; mimov25; qwen25omni; qwen3omni; qwen35omni; videoalmonn2; nemotron3omni). WorldSense (Worldsense),Daily-Omni (Dailyomni),OmniVideo Bench (omniviideobench),以及LVomni Bench (lvomnibench) 以此能力为基准. 联合AV Bench (coupavbench )明确评价跨模式依赖性. AV-Reasoner(叛国者)研究基于线索的计数和Video-MMMU(视频-MMU)测试从教学视频获得的知识。 与此相反,我们的基准要求对视听观测进行联合推理。

blocks.en:
Audio-visual instruction data. OmniVideo-100K ( omnivideo100k ) preserves cross-segment associations and audio-visual correspondence through entity-anchored scripts and clue-guided questions. OmniVideo-R1 ( omnivideor1 ) filters LLaVA-Video and Video-Vista questions for cross-modal grounding and fusion.
Our OmniQA leverages explicit evidence for question construction, dependency chains for thinking generation, and separate audio/visual clues for RL scoring, while extending video-derived knowledge to new inputs through reasoning beyond video .
blocks.zh:
视听教学资料. OmniVideo-100K(omniviideo-100k)通过实体化的编剧和线索引导的提问来保存跨区协会和视听通信. OmniVideo-R1 (omniviideor1) 滤波器 LLaVA-Video和Video-Vista问题,用于跨模式地面和聚变.
我们的OmniQA利用明确的证据来构建问题, 依赖链来创造思维,

blocks.en:
Reinforcement learning and self-distillation. Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) ( grpo ) develops group-relative outcome rewards while Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO) ( gspo ) considers sequence-level importance weighting. Video-R1 ( videor1 ) and OmniVideo-R1 ( omnivideor1 ) apply RL to video and audio-visual reasoning, and Video-KTR ( videoktr ) addresses key-token attribution.
On-policy self-distillation ( opsd ; sdpo ) converts additional context into token-level feedback, which RLSD ( rlsd ) maps to bounded, sign-preserving advantage weights.
We propose MFSD which retains RLSD’s weighting, outcome verifier, and policy objective, combining a centered interaction contrast from separate and joint clues with the joint-clue gain.
blocks.zh:
强化学习和自我消化。 集团相对政策优化(GRPO)(grpo )开发集团相对结果奖励,而集团序列政策优化(GSPO)(gspo)考虑序列级重要性加权. Video-R1 (visionr1)和OmniVideo-R1 (omnividor1)将RL应用于视频和视听推理,Video-KTR (visionktr)处理按键归属.
On political self-distaination (opsd; sdpo ) 将额外的上下文转换成符号级反馈,由 RLSD( rsd ) 映射到边框, 保留符号的优势权重 。
我们提议MFSD保留RLSD的权重、结果验证和政策目标, 将中心交互对比从单独和联合线索与联合线索收益相结合。

blocks.en: 3 Benchmark, Data Engine, and Learning Method
blocks.zh: 3 基准、数据引擎和学习方法

blocks.en: Our work, OmniReasoning, seeks to advance audio-visual joint reasoning with three components: an evaluation benchmark, a data engine, and a learning method. They are connected through explicit dependencies between audio and visual evidence. Specifically, the OmniQA data engine constructs both the questions of OmniReasoningBench and the training corpora, and its modality-specific clue annotations further provide the supervision signal for our learning method, MFSD.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作OmniReasoning力求推进视听联合推理,包括三个部分:评价基准、数据引擎和学习方法。 它们通过音频和视觉证据之间的明显依赖而连接。 具体来说,OmniQA数据引擎既构建了OmniReasoning Bench的问题,也构建了训练公司,其模式特有的线索说明进一步为我们学习方法MFSD提供了监督信号.

blocks.en: 3.1 OmniReasoningBench: A Benchmark for Audio-Visual Joint Reasoning
blocks.zh: 3.1 反响 座席:视听联合理由基准

blocks.en: OmniReasoningBench evaluates whether models can connect complementary audio and visual evidence to answer a question. It contains 750 reasoning over video and 400 reasoning beyond video questions, each with a reference answer and an annotated evidence chain (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: OmniReasoning Bench评价模型是否能够连接互补的音频和视觉证据来回答一个问题. 它包含750个对视频的推理和400个超越视频问题的推理,每个都有参考答案和附加注释的证据链(图2 ).

blocks.en: Figure 2: OmniReasoningBench tasks and examples. Reasoning over video connects observations across events; reasoning beyond video applies video-derived knowledge to a new scenario. Orange and blue mark audio and visual clues, with numbered markers linking evidence to timestamps.
blocks.zh: 图2:OmniReasoning Bench的任务和例子. 超越视频的原因将跨事件的观察联系起来;超越视频的推理将视频衍生的知识应用于新的情景. 橙色和蓝色标记的音频和视觉线索,其中编号标记将证据与时间戳联系起来.

blocks.en:
Reasoning over video .
These questions ask about the content within videos. Every answer can be derived by chaining multi-hop audio and visual evidence, and no single modality suffices. A spoken reference can identify which object to inspect, while a visible action can identify the relevant utterance. Correct answers therefore require joint reasoning over audio and visual evidence. This setting covers ten task types and includes 375 multiple-choice and 375 open-ended questions.
blocks.zh:
是因为视频的原因
问及影片内容。 每个答案都可以通过连锁多跳的音频和视觉证据来推导,没有单一模式就足够了. 口头参考可以确定检查对象,而可见的行动可以确定相关言论。 因此,正确答案需要联合推理,而不是视听证据。 这一设定涵盖10个任务类型,包括375个多重选择和375个开放式问题。

blocks.en:
Reasoning beyond video .
Omni reasoning can go beyond the understanding of a given video and transfer to new scenarios. The questions in this setting therefore ask models to carry knowledge acquired from a video into a new situation, figure, or numerical condition. For example, a spoken explanation and a visual demonstration establish a rule that must then be applied to a new diagram. In this case, the evidence chain still exists in the video, while the reasoning extends beyond it. There are in total 400 questions spanning nine task types, with 250 multiple-choice and 150 open-ended questions. Appendix provides the input-format breakdown.
blocks.zh:
超越视频的原因
Omni推理可以超越对特定视频的理解,转移到新的情景. 因此,这种背景下的问题要求模型将从录像中获得的知识带入新的情况、数字或数字条件。 例如,口头解释和视觉演示确立了一个规则,然后必须应用于新的图表。 在这种情况下,证据链在视频中依然存在,而推理则超越了它. 共有400个问题,涉及9个任务类型,包括250个多重选择和150个开放式问题。 附录提供了投入格式的细目。

blocks.en: Evidence of joint reasoning. On reasoning over video , joint inputs outperform a single-modality oracle that counts a question as solved whenever either the audio-only or the visual-only run answers it correctly. The gains range from 9.9 to 26.7 percentage points across three models and both question formats (Appendix ).
blocks.zh: 联合推理的证据. 在视频上进行推理时,联合输入比单一模式的预言要好,只要音频或视频运行正确,就把一个问题算作解决。 三个模型和两个问题格式的收益从9.9至26.7个百分点不等(附录)。

blocks.en: 3.2 OmniQA: A Data Engine for Audio-Visual Joint Reasoning
blocks.zh: 3.2 OmniQA:视听联合理由数据引擎

blocks.en: To preserve these evidence dependencies in training data, OmniQA constructs QA pairs together with timestamped audio and visual clues. The verified evidence chains guide thinking generation for SFT and provide modality-specific context for MFSD during RL (Figure 3 ).
blocks.zh: 为了在训练数据中保存这些证据的依赖性,OmniQA构建了QA配对,加上时间戳的音频和视觉线索. 经核实的证据链为SFT的思维生成提供指导,并为RL期间的MFSD提供特定模式上下文(图3 ).

blocks.en: Figure 3: OmniQA data engine. Gemini-3.1-Pro annotates timestamped audio-visual descriptions. Qwen3.8 generates QA pairs and reasoning steps, followed by clue validation and shortcut screening. Timestamped captions, verified QA pairs, and evidence chains then guide thinking generation.
blocks.zh: 图3:OmniQA数据引擎. 双子座-3.1-Pro 注释时间戳视听描述. Quen3.8生成QA对和推理步骤,之后是线索验证和快捷键筛选. 时标标题,核实QA对,证据链然后引导思维生成.

blocks.en: Figure 4: OmniReasoning released training-data distributions. The SFT and RL corpora span eight content domains, 25 production task types, and varied video durations.
blocks.zh: 图4:OmniReasoning发布培训数据分布. SFT和RL公司跨越8个内容域,25种制作任务类型,以及不同的视频持续时间.

blocks.en: Constructing questions from evidence. OmniQA segments each video into events and generates separate audio and visual descriptions with timestamps. Conditioned on these descriptions and a task specification, the question generator produces a question, a reference answer, and a dependency chain that links observations to intermediate inferences and the final answer. For multiple-choice questions, it also generates candidate options.
blocks.zh: 从证据中构建问题。 OmniQA将每段视频分解为事件,并生成带有时间戳的单独的音频和视觉描述. 基于这些描述和任务规格,问题生成器生成一个问题,一个参考答案,以及一个依赖链,将观察与中间推论和最后答案联系起来. 对于多选题,它也产生候选选项.

blocks.en: Verifying questions and clues. Structural checks validate the dependency graph, caption references, and timestamps. A caption-conditioned solver checks the reference answer, and a media verifier checks each clue against its supporting audio or visual clip. To screen for modality shortcuts, we evaluate each question under question-only, audio-only, visual-only, and joint audio-visual conditions. We retain a candidate only when its clues are valid, the joint condition yields the correct answer, and none of the restricted conditions does.
blocks.zh: 验证问题和线索. 结构检查验证依赖性图表、标题引用和时间戳。 一个带字幕条件的解析器检查参考答案,一个媒体核查员检查每一个线索与其支持的音频或视觉剪辑. 为了筛选模式快捷键,我们评价每个问题,只回答问题,只回答音频问题,只回答视觉问题,并评估联合视听条件。 我们只保留一个候选人 当它的线索是有效的, 联合条件产生正确的答案, 并且没有任何限制条件。

blocks.en: Generating thinking processes. The thinking generator receives timestamped audio and visual captions, the verified QA pair, the evidence chain, and any additional figure, but not the source video. It expands the chain into observations, intermediate inferences, and a final answer, comparing multiple-choice options and showing numerical calculations (Appendix ).
blocks.zh: 生成思维过程. 思维生成器收到时间标注的音频和视觉字幕,经核实的QA对,证据链,以及任何额外的数字,但不能收到源视频. 它将链条扩展为观测,中间推论,以及一个最终的答案,比较多个选择选项并显示数值计算(Appendix ).

blocks.en: Training datasets. The released datasets comprise OmniReasoning-SFT-112K , with 112,463 samples containing synthesized thinking processes, and OmniReasoning-RL-19K , with 18,991 human-validated questions and evidence annotations. Both cover reasoning over video and reasoning beyond video (Figure 4 ). During the SFT stage, the model learns from the synthesized responses. During the RL stage, the retained audio and visual clues, r A r_{A} and r V r_{V} , instead provide privileged context for evaluating the model’s sampled responses.
blocks.zh: 培训数据集。 发布数据集包括OmniReasoning-SFT-112K,包含合成思维过程的样本112,463个,OmniReasoning-RL-19K,包含18,991个经人验证的问题和证据说明. 两者都封面推理胜过视频,而推理胜过视频(图4). 在SFT阶段,该模型从综合响应中学习. 在RL阶段,保留下来的音频和视觉线索 r A r r r r r r r r v } 反而为评价模型的抽样反应提供了特权背景.

blocks.en: 3.3 Modality-Factored Self-Distillation: A Learning Method
blocks.zh: 3.3 模式 -- -- 促成自我分裂:学习方法

blocks.en:
The modality-specific clues created by OmniQA provide not only data annotations but also a learning signal for reinforcement learning.
Our method stems from RLSD ( rlsd ) , a widely adopted RL approach that re-scores a sampled response under privileged clue contexts and converts the resulting likelihood gains into token-level advantage weights.
However, a likelihood gain under joint audio-visual clues does not by itself indicate joint reasoning. The gain may come from one modality alone, so a response that exploits a single modality can receive the same guidance as one that genuinely integrates both. Therefore, we propose MFSD, which extends RLSD with cross-modality interaction guidance. Besides the joint-clue support used by RLSD, MFSD disentangles the likelihood gain that emerges only when audio and visual clues are combined, and uses the interaction signal for fine-grained token-level credit assignment (Figure 5 ).
blocks.zh:
OmniQA创建的模式特定线索不仅提供了数据说明,还提供了强化学习的学习信号.
我们的方法来源于RLSD(rlsd),一种被广泛采纳的RL方法,在特权线索上下文下对一个被抽样的响应进行重新评分,并将由此产生的概率收益转换成符号级优势权重.
然而,在联合视听线索下获得的可能性本身并不表明联合推理。 收益可能仅来自一种模式,因此利用一种模式的对策可以得到与真正将两者结合起来的相同指导。 因此,我们提出MFSD,将RLSD扩展为跨模式交互指导. 除了RLSD所使用的联合clue支持外,MFSD还解析了仅在音频和视觉线索结合时出现的概率增益,并使用交互信号进行精细的纹章级信用分配(图5).

blocks.en: Figure 5: Modality-Factored Self-Distillation. The actor scores the same response under four clue contexts. Joint-clue support and non-additive audio-visual interaction determine bounded token-level advantage weights.
blocks.zh: 图5:模式-因果自失常。 演员在四个线索上下文下得分相同的反应. 联合线索支持与非附加视听互动决定了限定符号级优势权重.

blocks.en:
MFSD. Given a question with its original audio-visual input, we first sample a group of responses without privileged clues, as in standard group-based reinforcement learning.
The same actor then scores each sampled response under four clue contexts: no clues, audio clues, visual clues, and joint audio-visual clues. The likelihood changes across these contexts yield two complementary evidence signals: the overall support provided by the joint clues, and the cross-modality interaction that neither modality explains individually.
Both signals are detached and converted into bounded token-level weights that modulate the outcome advantage.
blocks.zh:
(原始内容存档于2018-03-09). MFSD. 鉴于一个问题,我们用它最初的视听投入,首先抽取了一组没有特权线索的答复,如标准团体强化学习.
同一演员随后在四个线索背景下对每个样本回复进行评分:没有线索,音频线索,视觉线索,以及联合视听线索. 这些背景中的可能性变化产生了两个互补的证据信号:共同线索提供的总体支持,以及两种模式都无法单独解释的跨模式相互作用。
这两种信号都是脱落的,并转换成定界符号级的权重,以调节结果优势.

Centering removes the response-level mean of the interaction score, so the interaction term redistributes credit within a response rather than rescaling the response as a whole (Appendix ).
The coefficient β \beta balances these signals, and κ \kappa calibrates their scales (Appendix ).

The three clue-conditioned scoring views require no extra rollouts or separate teacher parameters.

blocks.en: Table 1: OmniReasoningBench accuracy (%). MCQ and OE denote multiple-choice and open-ended questions. Our model is initialized by Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking.
blocks.zh: 表1:OmniReasoning Bench精度(%)。 MCQ和OE表示多种选择和开放式问题。 我们的模型由 Quen3-Omni-30B-A3B-思潮初始化.
